state.question: Tell me about this building in two sentences: include its official name, completion year, designers and style from the record.
state.answer: The building is officially known as the Lettie Pate Whitehead Evans Administration Building, also called Tech Tower. It was completed in 1888, designed by Bruce and Morgan in the Romanesque Revival style.
state.supplied_evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://facilities.gatech.edu/sites/default/files/2023-05/histpresplan.pdf): Tech Tower is the Lettie Pate Whitehead Evans Administration Building. Completed in 1888, it was designed by Bruce and Morgan in the Romanesque Revival style. Its historical roles included teaching and administration.
